mode.system: Omit the attribute to follow the visitor's color scheme. Never pass a theme prop to components.

palette.target: html, or a container to theme one region
palette.default: Omit the attribute for the default palette.

default.label: Archive Teal
default.description: Deep teal primary and steel-blue secondary on cool mint surfaces. Calm and neutral; the root tokens.

tidal.label: Tidal Pool
tidal.description: Lagoon teal primary and terracotta coral secondary on pale aqua. Fresh and coastal.

sorbet.label: Sunset Sorbet
sorbet.description: Electric magenta primary and Capri cyan secondary on peach. Playful and loud.

orbit.label: Lunar Orbit
orbit.description: Ultraviolet primary and solar citron secondary on lavender. Futuristic and bold.

atelier.label: Cobalt Atelier
atelier.description: Klein cobalt primary and marigold secondary on ice blue. Confident and editorial.

canopy.label: Tropical Canopy
canopy.description: Malachite jade primary and neon orchid secondary on mint. Lush and energetic.

componentColor: A component's color prop names a semantic role (primary, secondary, success, error, warning, info, default, inherit). It is never a palette name or a CSS color.

motion.target: html for the whole app, any container for a region, or a component's motion prop. The nearest preset wins.
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce overrides every preset: no hover or press travel and no animation durations.

subtle.label: Subtle
subtle.description: Default. 1px lift on hover, 2% press, 150ms ease-out; overlays enter in 200ms.

ease-in-out.label: Ease in-out
ease-in-out.description: Subtle distances on a symmetric 200ms curve. Calm, deliberate interfaces.

expand-contract.label: Expand and contract
expand-contract.description: Grows 2% toward the pointer and contracts 3% when pressed; no vertical travel.

lift.label: Lift
lift.description: Rises 2px with a deeper shadow on hover and settles back when pressed; no scaling.

fade.label: Fade
fade.description: No movement: hover and press show as shadow and color changes only.

none.label: None
none.description: Instant: states still show, nothing animates.

lift-push.label: Lift and push
lift-push.description: Rises 3px like a key under the finger, then sinks into the surface when pressed: the drop shadow disappears and the inset shading deepens. Use for a few accents.

squish.label: Squish
squish.description: Flattens and widens like soft clay under a press, then regains its shape over 260ms. Use for a few accents.

tokens.--clay-motion-duration: Hover, focus, toggles and the release after a press.
tokens.--clay-motion-duration-enter: Dialogs, drawers, snackbars, badges and value changes appearing.
tokens.--clay-motion-easing: Timing function for every transition and entrance.
tokens.--clay-motion-press-drop: Outer shadow kept while pressed, as a fraction of depth.
tokens.--clay-motion-press-sink: Inset shading depth while pressed, as a multiple of depth.
tokens.--clay-motion-enter-y: Distance entering overlays and indicators travel.
tokens.--clay-motion-enter-scale: Starting scale of entering overlays and indicators.

overrides.brand: Override --clay-primary, --clay-primary-on (text on fill), and --clay-primary-ink (text on a surface) together. Check contrast in both modes. Do not set internal --c variables.
overrides.geometryTarget: Set on the surface element itself. Prefer a supported elevation, size or square prop before overriding CSS.
